recipes.name: insertion-guard
recipes.when: Require StreamCreation and show the exact rejected insertion type
recipes.test: rejects an unexpected insertion type with exact guard evidence

recipes.name: record-payloads-and-revisions
recipes.when: Record the complete append payload and exact fetched revision
recipes.test: records exact insertion payloads and fetched revisions

recipes.name: consistency-conflict-refetch
recipes.when: Prove a conflict refetches, re-decides, drops the stale payload, and appends after the fresh revision
recipes.test: records the exact insertion precondition after refetch
recipes.fault: submit the stale revision on the second append attempt

recipes.name: postgres-append-barrier
recipes.when: Coordinate two PostgreSQL appends at the same expected position without sleeps
recipes.test: will only allow one event to be appended, when two writers try to append at the same time

recipes.name: stream-creation-race
recipes.when: Race two StreamCreation appends and verify one durable creation fact
recipes.test: allows only one concurrent StreamCreation and persists one creation fact
recipes.fault: turn both creations into unconditional appends

recipes.name: any-stream-state
recipes.when: Prove two stale concurrent AnyStreamState appends both persist in durable order
recipes.test: persists both AnyStreamState events in durable order
recipes.fault: impose a stale InsertAfter precondition on one append
